in_marathi.name: Uttamya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Uttamya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Uttamya originates from Sanskrit, meaning 'the highest' or 'supreme'. It is a unisex name often given to children born into Hindu families.

in_bengali.name: Uttamya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ The Highest
in_bengali.long_meaning: Uttamya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Uttamya originates from Sanskrit, meaning 'the highest' or 'supreme'. It is a unisex name often given to children born into Hindu families.
